experience: Google's PM loop is heavy on Product Sense and Strategy. I had 5 rounds onsite: Product Design (Improve YouTube's recommendation), Strategy (What should Google build in 5 years?), Analytical (Estimate time spent at stop lights), Technical (Explain an SDK to a 7-year-old), and Googleyness. For design questions, always use a framework like CIRCLES. They care about user empathy more than the actual solution. Got an offer after 2 months.

Applied via referral. Phone screen was a design question: 'Design an app for an amusement park.' Onsite had a tricky estimation question about market sizing for a new VR product. Technical round was system design: 'What happens when you click search on Google?' Behavioral focused on stakeholder management and 'Tell me about a time you made a mistake.' Frameworks are key.
